digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge runner and CI integration
propositions: Extract bridge orchestration into a runner-neutral packaged Python core exposed through library, CLI, and MCP interfaces with support for pip, Homebrew wheel, and MCP Registry/uvx install shapes.

Preserve five execution profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) and legacy MODE environment variable compatibility while using canonical profile noun in public surfaces.
Provider wrappers must validate against pinned schemas, lint embedded shell with ShellCheck 0.11.0, and invoke only the installed `rebar bridge run` command without repository-local scripts.
Runner translates legacy benign results (3/4/75) to canonical success while preserving operational error (1) and invalid invocation (2) for direct legacy callers.
Strict delivery must execute on every successful non-paused pass with run id, bot identity, and REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always; malformed pause markers must not silently skip delivery.
